description: Header file defining the CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher class, which implements cookie change dispatching for CookieMonster, including subscription management and callback registration.

classes.name: CookieMonsterChangeDispatcher
classes.description: Implements cookie change dispatching, manages subscriptions, and handles callback registration for cookie changes.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Represents a subscription to cookie change events, manages callback invocation, and handles filtering based on domain, name, and URL.

methods.name: NameKey
methods.description: Returns a key string for a cookie name.

methods.name: DomainKey
methods.description: Returns a key string for a cookie domain or URL.

methods.name: AddCallbackForCookie
methods.description: Registers a callback for changes to a specific cookie identified by URL and name.

methods.name: AddCallbackForUrl
methods.description: Registers a callback for changes related to a specific URL.

methods.name: AddCallbackForAllChanges
methods.description: Registers a callback for all cookie changes.

methods.name: DispatchChange
methods.description: Dispatches a cookie change event to relevant subscribers, optionally notifying global hooks.
